items.summary: Audio recording of the discussion on the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
Reliance Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation.
Media release on the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
Board approved the unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
Board passed resolution authorising issuance of redeemable non-convertible debentures up to Rs. 15,000 crore.
Disclosure on voluntary strike off of Hamleys (Franchising) Limited.
Trading in equity shares of Jio Platforms Limited will commence from October 28, 2026.
Board meeting scheduled to approve financial results and fund raising on October 30, 2026.
Initial Public Offer of Jio Platforms Limited opened for subscription on October 21, 2026.
A media statement issued by the Company is attached.
